name: Household monthly budget
audience: Households in South Africa who want a monthly plan in rand, including households with one main salary and a smaller second income.
summary: A rand budget that separates take-home pay, committed costs, and what is left to save.
description: Plan one household month from net pay. The workbook totals income, totals each cost you list, and shows the surplus and two ratios: savings and housing.
benefits: See surplus after the costs you actually listed
Check whether housing is taking more than you intended
Keep a written note next to every figure
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
